name: How do minor repairs compare to major renovations in terms of return on investment for selling?

mainEntity.name: How do minor repairs compare to major renovations in terms of return on investment for selling?

acceptedAnswer.text: Minor repairs and cosmetic updates often provide a higher return on investment (ROI) for selling than major renovations. Buyers typically expect a well-maintained home, and addressing small flaws, fresh paint, or updated fixtures can significantly enhance appeal without breaking the bank. Major renovations, while impactful, might not always recoup their full cost upon sale, especially if they cater to niche tastes. Focus on general appeal and functional integrity to maximize your selling price.
acceptedAnswer.description: Minor repairs and cosmetic updates generally offer a higher return on investment for selling than major renovations, as they broadly appeal to buyers without excessive cost.
